author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** Replace NotWiredEvidenceFetcher in main.rs with a real impl using proto_blue_api::com::atproto::sync::{describeRepo, getRecord, getBlocks} query bindings. The fetcher: from a record AT-URI like at://did:plc:abc/app.bsky.feed.post/k1, calls describeRepo on the PDS to discover the commit root, then getRecord to fetch the record CID + its MST proof path. Returns BlockMap suitable for proto_blue_repo::blocks_to_car. New EvidenceFetcher trait already exists — implement it. Optional PLC-directory lookup for handle→PDS resolution (use proto_blue_identity::IdResolver which we already use elsewhere).
